title: Programming Basics: Variables & Input
welcome_lead: Variables store data so your program can remember and reuse it.
meta_desc: KS3 programming basics: variables, data types, input and output.
final_note: Get variables right and the rest of programming clicks into place.

walkthroughs.body_html: A variable is a labelled box. You give it a name and put a value in. Later your program looks it up by name, e.g. age = 13.
Common types: string (text in quotes), integer (whole number), float (decimal), boolean (True or False).
input() reads from the user and returns text. print() shows output. Convert text to number with int() when needed.
